findings.highlight: In that last moment, she just felt that this was the best thing to do.
findings.evidenceJa: ようするにさっきの瞬間、ここ一番っていう時に気付いてしまった。
findings.governingReading: In the crucial last moment she suddenly realizes she cannot kill Sakura up close.
findings.explanation: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.

findings.governingReading: After asking where error occurred she realizes everything she wanted was present right before her.
findings.explanation: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.
